an3.71:1.2: atha kho channo paribbājako yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an3.71:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho channo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca :
an3.71:1.4: tumhepi āvuso ānanda, rāgassa pahāṇaṃ paññāpetha. dosassa …pe… mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpethāti.
an3.71:1.5: mayaṃ kho āvuso, rāgassa pahāṇaṃ paññāpema, dosassa …pe… mohassa pahāṇaṃ paññāpemāti.
an3.71:2.1: kimpana tumhe āvuso, rāge ādīnavaṃ disvā rāgassa pahāṇaṃ paññāpetha. kiṃ dose …pe… mohe ādīnavaṃ disvā mohassa pahānaṃ paññāpethāti.
an3.71:3.1: ratto kho āvuso, rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāyapi ceteti, para …pe… ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:3.2: rāge pahīṇe nevattavyābādhāya ceteti, na para …pe… na ubhaya …pe… na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:3.3: ratto kho āvuso, rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya …pe… manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:3.4: rāge pahīṇe neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, na vācāya …pe… na manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:3.5: ratto kho āvuso, rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, paratthampi …pe… ubhayatthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappapajānāti.
an3.71:3.6: rāge pahīṇe attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, paratthampi …pe… ubhayatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.71:3.7: rāgo kho āvuso, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
an3.71:4.2: mūḷho kho āvuso, mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāyapi ceteti, …pe… ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:4.3: mohe pahīṇe nevattavyābādhāya ceteti, na para …pe… na ubhaya …pe… na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.71:4.4: mūḷho kho āvuso, mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:4.5: mohe pahīṇe neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, na vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, na manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.71:4.6: mūḷho kho āvuso, mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, paratthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. ubhayatthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an3.71:4.7: mohe pahīṇe attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, paratthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ubhayatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.71:4.8: moho kho āvuso, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
an3.71:4.9: idaṃ kho mayaṃ āvuso, rāge ādīnavaṃ disvā rāgassa pahāṇaṃ paññāpema.
an3.71:4.10: idaṃ dose ādīnavaṃ disvā dosassa pahānaṃ paññāpema.
an3.71:4.11: idaṃ mohe ādīnavaṃ disvā mohassa pahāṇaṃ paññāpemāti.
an3.71:5.1: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti?
an3.71:5.2: atthāvuso, maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahānāyāti.
an3.71:5.3: katamo panāvuso, maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahāṇāyāti?
an3.71:5.6: ayaṃ kho āvuso, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahāṇāyāti.
an3.71:5.7: bhaddako kho āvuso, maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa rāgassa dosassa mohassa pahāṇāyāyati.
